MODE 2-8: 1/X

Inverse regression y = A + B/x.

keys
MODE→2→8

Reciprocal physical relationships.

formula
y=A+xB​

A hyperbola: large when x is small, then levelling toward A. x must not be zero.

steps

Open this type

  1. MODE→2→8
  2. Clear or edit data in the Statistics Editor as needed
  3. AC, then SHIFT 1 (STAT) for Var / Reg / MinMax recalls
